title: 印度IT看似便宜：外资却说，拐点未至
speaker: Pukesai

segments.en: For the IT software and services companies, we are monitoring the earnings closely. And I would say that from a broader perspective, that hasn't really turned the corner too much, because even those of these companies are benefiting from increasing AI workload.
segments.zh: 对于IT软件和服务公司，我们正在密切监控其盈利。从更广的角度看，行业尚未明显好转，尽管这些公司也受益于AI工作负载的增加。

segments.en: Some part of their businesses are also going through deflation in terms of the prices that they can charge.
segments.zh: 他们部分业务也面临定价通缩的压力。

segments.en: We are still in that equilibrium-finding phase, and we are closely monitoring for that inflection point. It is looking attractive as cheap, but I think from a fundamental perspective, it remains a close monitoring.
segments.zh: 我们仍处于寻找平衡的阶段，正在密切监控拐点。估值看起来便宜，但从基本面看，仍需密切关注。
